veranderings.na: Afrika se drie grootste mere lê almal
veranderings.rede: 'hierdie mere' points back to lakes the text has not yet named (only the heading does); the block should stand on its own.
A waterfall lies 'op' a river in Afrikaans, as the subject's other lessons write it ('lê op die Oranjerivier').
'hoogste' and 'boonste' say the same thing here; the doubling is redundant.
